title: My Dress-Up Darling
native_title: その着せ替え人形は恋をする
source: My Dress-Up Darling manga by Shinichi Fukuda (finished).
world: Shy high-schooler Wakana Gojo trains to be a hina doll craftsman like his grandfather and hides his love of dolls. Popular gyaru classmate Marin Kitagawa discovers his sewing skills and asks him to make her cosplay costumes. Their cosplay projects pull in new friends and slowly turn into a sweet romance. A warm, colourful story about passion and accepting what you love.
power_system: No powers. The focus is cosplay craft: costumes, wigs, make-up, photography and doll making.
